summary: Verified the feet-plant/sink fix (visual scale origin moved to foot line + footBaseY at physics box edge) in /app/frontend/src/game/character.tsx on the live web preview at 900x420 viewport. (A) IDLE on 1-1: zoomed clip (4x) shows boot soles sitting EXACTLY on the ground tile top edge - no sinking into the tile, no floating gap. (B) AFTER LANDING: jump tapped via btn-jump, post-land zoomed clip shows feet flush on the tile line again, character upright, all parts attached. (C) MOVING: held btn-right mid-run clip shows legs animating with boots at the ground contact line (run-swing lift within expected pose range), run-trail streaks behind, no sinking. (D) GRAVITY FLIP on /game/4-1: route has NO lock gate so direct navigation worked (no localStorage injection needed); held btn-right, character hit the swirl at col 4, flipped, and ran along the CEILING - 6x zoom confirms boots touching the ceiling underside, head pointing DOWN, visor/crest mirrored, wrist ring attached, nothing clipped into the ceiling. Character then reached the portal and the level COMPLETED (ESCAPED modal, grade S, 3 stars, Echoes 0/Par 0), proving the full flip-to-exit flow. (E) REGRESSION PASS: hud-timer counting, ECHO 0/0 pill, btn-pause/btn-restart/btn-left/btn-right/btn-jump all visible and responsive on both levels; ZERO console errors on both pages. Verdict: feet-plant fix VERIFIED in idle, landed, running, and gravity-flipped states.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Feet-plant fix fully verified (idle/landed/run/flipped). Test technique that worked: 900x420 viewport, clip screenshots (PNG, no quality opt) upscaled 4-6x with PIL Image.NEAREST for pixel inspection; controls via mouse.down/up on [data-testid=btn-left|btn-right|btn-jump]; full-page screenshots are auto-saved as .jpeg by the tool while clips stay .png. Level 4-1 completes in <3s by just holding btn-right (spawn->swirl at col4->ceiling run->portal col19), so capture the hanging pose within ~2s of holding right or restart the loop first. Timer counts down from 10s and the loop auto-resets on expiry - timer values increasing between shots means a reset occurred.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: VISUAL_SCALE 1.35 was applied about the sprite CENTER and boot geometry ended 2px above the physics box bottom, so boot soles rendered ~2.2px below the ground plane (character visually sank into platforms). Fix (visual-only): (1) footBaseY anchored to y+h-2 (y+2 when flipped) so boots end exactly at the physics box edge; (2) scale origin moved to the foot line (y+h, or y when flipped). Verified via zoomed screenshots: soles flush with tile top in idle/landed/run poses and flush with ceiling underside when gravity-flipped. No physics, collision, or hitbox changes.
